description: Declare a custom contact property. Not required before setting one on a contact — an undeclared property registers itself as a string — but declaring it is what allows a type and a fallback value. The key and type cannot be changed afterwards.

fallbackValue.description: Substituted into {{key}} for contacts carrying no value of their own. Must match the type.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter; at most 40 characters. "email", "name", "first_name", "last_name" and "full_name" are built in and are rejected here.

type.description: Defaults to string. Values render as strings either way — "number" is a write-time check, not formatting.

name: create_contact_property
title: Declare a contact property
